summary: Iter 265 frontend-only verification: mobile tab strip fix in SettingsModal. All primary bug-verification assertions PASSED with pixel-perfect measurements. Also spot-checked backend health/login for regression.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsModal.tsx line 66-83: fix is clean and minimal. flex-shrink-0 prevents flex compression at narrow widths; border-b-2 on both active AND inactive (border-transparent for inactive) equalises button height so switching does not cause 1-2px vertical layout shift; -mb-px removal confirmed (not present in source). scroll-smooth + overflow-x-auto correctly enables horizontal swipe of nav when scrollWidth (517) > clientWidth (359) at 375px viewport. Outer container p-2 sm:p-4 gives 8px mobile / 16px desktop gap from viewport edges (verified: card.x=8, card.right-gap=8 at 375px).

backend/src/server.ts validateEmailSender IIFE (code review only, per request): guard runs at boot after REQUIRED_SECRETS check. In dev it should only warn (non-fatal); in prod (NODE_ENV=production) it should call process.exit(1). Ensure the guard runs BEFORE any Prisma/route wiring so a mis-configured prod boot fails fast without partial services. Recommend also logging the specific failing sender (from address) so ops can diagnose without stack trace.

backend/src/services/email.ts sendPaymentNudge (code review only, per request): migration to buildEmailTemplate is consistent with the pattern used by other transactional emails in this file (inquiry ack, contract reminder etc). Ensure buildEmailTemplate parameters (subject, preheader, body, ctaUrl/ctaLabel) are all provided so the template does not render empty CTA button; also ensure recipient's timezone/currency formatting is preserved if the pre-migration version had custom locale handling.

success_rate.backend: N/A (only health+login regression checked, both PASS)

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: The [data-testid="settings-modal"] element is the FULL-VIEWPORT BACKDROP (fixed inset-0), NOT the modal card. To measure card gaps/position use `backdrop.firstElementChild` — the card has max-h-[90dvh] w-full max-w-4xl. Sidebar-settings testid is visible=false on mobile (sidebar hidden); click via page.evaluate() DOM click bypasses overlay. Welcome tour + cookie banner still trigger on login; dismiss loop with 'Accept All'/'Awesome!'/'Next'/'Skip tour'. networkidle waitUntil times out on this SPA (Vite HMR keeps sockets open) — use waitUntil='domcontentloaded' + explicit wait_for_timeout. Bottom nav on mobile also has data-testid='bottom-nav-settings' (visible variant of sidebar-settings).
